name: Password sign-in with advanced policy
description: Replacement of the base password method with a configurable password policy: length and character classes, denied content (login, name, e-mail, forbidden and common words), reuse history and expiry. Verified at creation and change by the core; hashes and history never leave the core credential store.

settings.label: Maximum password length
settings.help: The core credential store caps passwords at 128 characters.

settings.label: Character classes required (0 = off)
settings.help: How many of the four classes (uppercase, lowercase, digit, symbol) a password must use. Length usually matters more than complexity; leave at 0 to not require classes.

settings.label: Forbid the login, name or e-mail in the password
Forbidden words (a password containing one is refused)
Refuse the most common passwords (small built-in list)
settings.help: A short built-in list of very common passwords, not a breach corpus. For a real product, plug a breached-password corpus here.

settings.label: Previous passwords that cannot be reused (0 = only the current one)
settings.help: The core keeps the salted hashes of previous passwords outside the database and hands them to this check. 24 stored at most.

settings.label: Password expiry in days (0 = never)
settings.help: Applies from the next password change (the core knows the change date only for passwords set while history is active). An expired password is refused at sign-in: the person asks an administrator for a reset.
